Name: Four Corners Farm Remade by Nosorius
Author: Nosorius
Description:
[b][size=3][u]What is this?[/u][/size]
[/b]This is a modified farm map of the original Four Corners Farm. I wasn't a big fan of the implementation of the original Four Corners with all the cliffs, so I have created this as an alternative; the same "four farms in a single map" concept but with my flair instead :p

The niches of the Four Corners are also available in this version. That being; 
Top left: Specialized in foresting, has grass areas that you can plant trees but not much so farming, also one area containing a large stump spawn. Also weeds here can transform into the unique ones that always drop mixed seeds, the same as on the Forest Farm.
Bottom left: Specialized for fishing, it has a large lake and dock, players can catch forest pond fish types.
Bottom right: Specialized in mining, contains a small quarry that spawns rocks, ores and geodes.

This map is a detailed modification of the original one. It is as vanilla as possible; it has no custom tilesets, no complicated scripts and code added, no big adjustments to the map itself to avoid any unforeseeable complications.

[b][size=3][u]Versions / How does this work?[/u][/size]
[/b]I've included two versions for this mod.
The normal version uses SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Thanks for their fantastic work, using their systems ensures just a few lines  of code on my end is all it takes to make a call for this map to load  instead of the original map, without deleting or replacing the original  map file itself.

Alternatively... alternative version is for use without dependencies, it is to directly replace the original map.
In case there are users that cannot use or do not wish to use these  dependencies, they can simply replace the original file with this file
to use this map.

[b][u][size=3]Usable in co-op?[/size][/u]
[/b]Yes. You need to make sure all players have the mod installed.

[size=3][b][u]Do I need to start a new farm?
[/u][/b][/size]No, but highly recommended that you start anew. When you change a map with this for an already established farm, you will still have the pathing from the old map, including things like trees and bushes, which will cause issues. IE; you might see unremovable bushes out in middle of the farm that shouldn't be.

[size=3][b][u]Bugs and Issues
[/u][/b][/size]No important bugs or glitches.

One minor issue is that when you open the world map by pressing M, you will see a representation of what looks like the original farm instead of a representation of this map.
I've avoided making edits on the world map itself to ensure just in case an user has any other mods that also edits the world map, in case there will be issues of conflict.

One minor issue is, entering the farm from the south (forest), your character will spawn a few tiles north instead of the very edge of the map.
I've decided to make it work as it is because to make it otherwise, the forest map had to be edited and that will cause conflicts with mods that also edit this map.

I've generally kept major things as they are to avoid bugs, glitches and issues and to ensure maximum compatibility.

[b][u][size=3]Installation / Uninstallation[/size][/u][/b]
[u]For normal version;[/u]
Make sure to install SMAPI.
Make sure to install Content Patcher.

If you are using a mod manager (vortex),
Download the file through mod manager, install and activate.
Manager may ask you for elevation of the mods, make sure to do that before launching the game.

If you are not using a mod manager or you wish to manually install the normal version,
Download the file manually.
Extract the folder.
You will need to move the folder "Four Corners Farm Remade by Nosorius" into "Mods" folder, which is inside your game directory. (your drive:\game  directory\Stardew Valley\Mods). Your game directory is based on platform you use; steam, gog, xbox etc.

[u][b][size=3]For alternative version (Replacer. No SMAPI and CP);
Instructions also included in readme;[/size][/b][/u]
Download the file.
Navigate to your game directory. It should look like "your drive:\your game directory\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps". Your game directory is based on platform you use; steam, gog, xbox etc.
Make a backup copy of "Farm_FourCorners.xnb" file to another location.
Extract "Farm_FourCorners.xnb" file you have downloaded into the folder.
Confirm prompt for replacement.
To uninstall and revert back to the original map, place the original file you have saved back into the folder. Alternatively, you can always
simply reinstall the game to get the original files if you've lost it.
